title: Choosing a cart turn on the dispatch map
titleZh: 依出貨圖選擇手推車轉向

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Look at the dispatch map. We’re moving a tall load on the blue cart. When the cart turns, the boxes block your view of the inside of the bend. Choose a turn toward packing with no doorway on that inside edge. The wash bay isn’t on this delivery route. Another team is using the map for an empty cart today. Their view is clear, so they don’t use our tall-load rule. Write your turn letter on the dispatch slip before leaving the loading lane.
turns.zh: 請看出貨區平面圖。我們要用藍色手推車運一批堆得較高的貨。推車轉彎時，箱子會擋住你的視線，讓你看不到彎道內側。請選通往包裝區、而且彎道內側沒有門口的轉向。清洗區不在這趟運送路線上。今天還有一組人會用這張圖推空車。他們視線不受阻擋，所以不用套用我們這條高貨物規則。離開裝貨通道前，請在出貨單上寫下所選轉彎點的字母。

Turn B ends at Wash bay and its marker is right of that path. Turn C ends at Packing and its marker is right of that path. Turn D ends at Packing and its marker is left of that path.
visualAltZh: 四格平面圖的路徑都由左方進入，再向下轉。A 通往包裝區，門口記號位於向下路徑左側；B 通往清洗區，門口記號位於該路徑右側；C 通往包裝區，門口記號在右側；D 通往包裝區，門口記號在左側。
